notes: Hardening pass over the 0.1.5 features. The 'What changed' page no longer fails to draw a diff on machines where two installed programs share a display name (common on a gaming PC with several bundled VC++ redistributables). Storage explorer sizes a full drive much faster. The component-store analysis has a time limit and reports DISM's own error text. Battery health reads the runtime estimate correctly. Plus smaller fixes to the pending-restart check.
